verdict.rationale: Chroma exposes a documented public API (client libraries, REST/OpenAPI schema, CLI) confirmed by both official docs and a live probe of its openapi.json, plus llms.txt for AI-native discovery, and it is explicitly promoted for use by AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to set up and query the DB. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking or hands-on developer confirmation of API robustness beyond vendor docs/probes.
